SAKURA_MOD_EVENT_CLASSIC_TOMOYO_ANCIENT_: Tomoyo Daidouji
The Costume Designer
Sakura, I finally found you! I brought several battle costumes made especially for you.
Listen
Tomoyo? How did you get here?
Ask
I made these for you. Pick the costume that matches the cards in your heart.
You look wonderful, Sakura! Which one shall we film first?
I also filmed Kero-chan sneaking snacks earlier! Behind-the-scenes footage like that is priceless.
Explain
Tomoyo... please don't record Kero stealing sweets too!
Continue
Hehe, wherever you are, Sakura, every single frame is pure perfection.
Everyone in the Spire wears such unusual outfits... though of course, you're still the cutest of all, Sakura!
Thank
Thank you for always bringing these costumes to find me, Tomoyo!
A costume can make a brave heart even braver.
Tomoyo unveils three carefully prepared battle costumes.
Tomoyo waves as the chosen costume settles perfectly into place.
Choose the Clow Card battle costume.
Gain the Red Cape Costume.
Choose the Sakura Card battle costume.
Gain the Pink Costume.
Choose the Clear Card battle costume.
Gain the Frog Raincoat.
NEOW.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC_S:
[sine]...Starlight... ..and unfamiliar.. ..magic.....
...Little one... ..you are not... a warrior.. of this place....[/sine]
Um... excuse me, is this beneath the Spire? I think I got separated from everyone...
I don't want to hurt anyone... I just want every card and everyone to return where they belong.
What a scary aura... Still, if this is a disturbance I have to resolve, everything will definitely be alright!
DARV.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC_S:
Whoa there! Kid, that hardcover book on your back is actually glowing!!
Let Darv take a peek—what kind of treasure you hiding in there?!
Ah, no, no! I can't just give away the cards inside the Sealed Book!

Alright, alright, protective little thing aren't ya!
Tell you what—take a shiny from MY pile instead!!
Hey, that little yellow puffball floating by your shoulder... don't tell me he's a living magical collectible too?!
[i][font_size=22]Cerberus clutches his snack nervously and edges half a step behind Sakura.[/font_size][/i]
Haha! Relax, relax, I don't hoard a kid's friends. Go pick yourself a relic!

I actually found a card clear as glass once, covered in weird markings...
Too bad it shattered soon as it touched the Architect's magic, uh... oops.
A clear card...? Could there be stray magical cards here too?
Forget I said anything, forget I said anything!! Just grab your pick and keep climbing!

Wands! Cards! Sparkly star badges!
You magical girls carry the best stuff for a display shelf!!
OROBAS.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC:
WHOA!! A glowing stick!! With little wings and a star!!
AND flying cards!! How do you do that?! Do it again!!
Hehe, it's my magic! If you'd like to see, I can draw a card for you!

AMAZING!! So sparkly!! Not scary at all!!
Take this!! I love new friends who hate fighting!!

Story time!! Story time!!
Did the golden dessert-loving little lion come adventuring with you today?!
Kero-chan was actually just complaining that there's no pudding or takoyaki around here...
What's pudding?! Sounds squishy and shiny!! Take this and bring pudding next time!!

The Architect up top used to love making pretty things too, long ago!
He just got so lonely after...
Lonely...? Then when I see him, I'll try talking things out nicely first!
Talking is good!! Way better than fighting!! Good luck, magic girl!!

All your cards together shine like a rainbow!!
Just like me!! Pick your favorite and go!!
PAEL.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC_S:
[thinky_dots]Such warm magic... like a gentle dream before waking...
Little mage, who do you carry inside your dreams...?[/thinky_dots]
Everyone is waiting for me to come home... so even in a dream, I have to keep going.

[thinky_dots]What a kind child...
Take a part of me, and let it shield you from the storm...[/thinky_dots]
[i][font_size=22]Pael lets out a soft, rumbling snore, and Sakura can't help letting out a tiny yawn of her own.[/font_size][/i]
Mmf... I almost fell asleep right there... I need to stay sharp!

[thinky_dots]Your cards hold echoes of Sleep and Dream...
When you reach the summit, please try not to hurt [red]Father[/red]...[/thinky_dots]
Mm, I promise! There has to be a way without hurting anyone.
[thinky_dots]How nice... If only Father could have a pleasant dream like you... zZZzz...[/thinky_dots]

[thinky_dots]Time and memory can weigh so heavy...
If you grow tired, take some of my strength and rest awhile...[/thinky_dots]
TEZCATARA.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLAS:
My, my, what a polite little sweetheart!
It's cold and dark out there—come inside and try some freshly baked [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter]!
Ooh, it smells amazing! Thank you, ma'am! Do you like baking pancakes and cookies too?

Hehe... I bake them nice and slow over the brightest [jitter][b]hearthfire[/b][/jitter].
Eat up, dearie—you'll need your strength ahead!
Come now, hand over any dusty old habits in your deck, and let me [jitter][b]burn them clean[/b][/jitter] for you!
That fire looks a tiny bit scary... but thank you for being so kind!
That light and fire swirling around you reminds me of a grand sorcerer I once met...
A sorcerer...? Could you mean Clow Reed...?
Who can say~ Whenever you're not in a rush, stay for [jitter][b]tea[/b][/jitter] and I'll tell you all about it!

So full of pep every single visit—you're making my hearthfire look shy!
Tell me what you need today, sweetie!
NONUPEIPE.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLAS:
Oh my, finally a visitor with genuine [sine]taste[/sine]!
Those delicate ribbons and pleats—who tailored such an adorable battle outfit for you?
My best friend Tomoyo made this battle costume by hand! Isn't it amazing?!
Such exquisite craftsmanship! A young lady of refinement naturally deserves my finest blessings.
Servants! Pour our little mage the finest black tea, and bring out the strawberry shortcake!
Thank you so much, Lady Nonupeipe! Both the tea and the cake are delicious!

The Architect built this Spire so drab and gray—not an ounce of charm or beauty!
Only your magic and wardrobe bloom like flowers here.
I wish everyone here could just relax and wear nice clothes together...
Spoken like a true star! Go on, dress wonderfully and sweep away this gloom!

Your friend is truly a gifted designer...
Be sure to bring one of her creations next time so I may admire it properly!
TANX.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC_S:
[b]TINY ONE!! WHAT KIND OF WEAPON IS THAT PINK WINGED STICK IN YOUR HAND?!
CAN IT EVEN CRUSH A HELMET?![/b]
I-it's not a club for bonking people! It's the Sealed Wand—it summons Sword and all kinds of magic!
[b]IT SUMMONS SWORDS?! NOT BAD THEN!! TAKE A REAL WEAPON TOO AND FIGHT!![/b]
[b]QUIT BLOWING WIND AND WATER AROUND!! CARDS ALONE AREN'T ENOUGH—PICK A MIGHTY WEAPON!![/b]
[i][font_size=22]Sakura hastily raises her wand to block Tanx's blow with Shield, and slips a piece of candy into his paw.[/font_size][/i]
[b]YOU [jitter]BLOCKED[/jitter] THAT?! AND THIS SWEET LITTLE THING... MY STRENGTH IS SURGING!! GOOD!![/b]
[b]WHERE'S THAT LITTLE GOLDEN FLYING BEAST?! BRING HIM OUT TO SPAR WITH ME TOO!![/b]
VAKUU.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_CLASSIC_:
How peculiar... a soul without a single shadow wandering inside these cursed walls.
Lost little girl, wouldn't you like to return straight to your warm home?
Dad, Touya, and everyone are waiting for me... but Yukito and Tomoyo taught me never to accept strange bargains!
Sharp instincts, I see. [sine]No matter[/sine]... should you ever feel helpless, my contract awaits.
[i][font_size=22]Vakuu unfurls a pitch-black scroll, and the Light and Dark cards at Sakura's chest chime faintly in warning.[/font_size][/i]
If I borrow power, I only need my own star magic and my cards!

What do you fear losing most? Your friends' smiles, or ordinary days you can never regain?
Sign here, and I can seal that moment forever.
No! Memories of moving forward together aren't meant to be locked inside a contract!
Stubborn to the point of amusement... Let us see how far "[sine]everything will be alright[/sine]" carries you.

You carry Darkness and Nothingness at your side, yet insist on standing in the light?
Come now, even one tiny bargain...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SAKURA_MOD_CHARACTER_: Are you the one who created this place? Why does everyone have to keep fighting in the Spire...
The Spire requires order. Outsiders need only obey its rules.
If this is an incident out of control, I'll find a way to send everyone home!
Neither vengeance nor obsession burns in your eyes. Why return before me again?
Because everyone trapped fighting here has suffered enough! And... I want to untangle your heart too.
Even if I have to start over every time, I'm never giving up!
Warm magic, yet it cannot save anyone.
Even if my power is small, I have to try! Because... everything will definitely be alright!
Cards of stars, elements, dreams, and time... this place has no room for superfluous miracles.
They aren't superfluous miracles—they're the courage everyone lent to me!
